_comment: Gate 2 of perf/run.py. For each other framework: the minimum allowed value of (Ligero overall throughput on its own Loom engine / that framework's overall throughput), measured in the same run. The floors are calibrated on the GitHub-hosted runner the Benchmark workflow uses (measured there: 1.40x Javalin, 2.60x Spring Boot), with a margin for noise; a developer machine may show a larger lead. Raise a floor when Ligero gains ground on the runner so the gain cannot be lost again; never lower one to make a PR pass.
